hikes.name: Hoffer Lakes and Anthony Lake
hikes.blurb: A short climb from Anthony Lake to two meadow lakes under the granite Elkhorn crest.

hikes.name: Black Lake
hikes.blurb: An easy walk to a dark lake tucked against Gunsight Mountain.

hikes.name: Rock Creek Lake
hikes.blurb: From Rock Creek Lake Trailhead, a 6.6-mile round trip to Rock Creek Lake, with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Killamacue Lake
hikes.blurb: From Killamacue Trailhead, a 5.8-mile round trip to Killamacue Lake, with about 1,850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Red Mountain Lake
hikes.blurb: From Summit Lake Trailhead, a 4.6-mile round trip to Red Mountain Lake, with about 1,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Summit Lake
hikes.blurb: From Summit Lake Trailhead, a 2.5-mile round trip to Summit Lake, with about 1,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Twin Lakes
hikes.blurb: From Marble Pass Trailhead, an 8.3-mile round trip to Twin Lakes, with about 950 feet of climbing.
